items.title: Cam Ward: Little production in loss to Browns
items.text:
Ward completed 20 of 31 passes for 181 yards with an interception in Sunday's 27-24 loss to Cleveland. He added five yards on two carries.

items.title: Tony Pollard: Cashes three TDs in tough loss
items.text:
Pollard carried the ball 25 times for 129 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns. He also caught all three of his targets for 26 yards.

items.title: Jaylen Waddle: Exits in fourth quarter
items.text:
Waddle (undisclosed) headed to the locker room in the fourth quarter of Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

items.title: Harold Fannin: Season high in receiving yards Sunday
items.text:

items.title: Kyle Pitts: Another TD in Week 7 win
items.text:
Pitts brought in all five targets for 22 yards and a touchdown in the Falcons' 29-20 win over the 49ers on Sunday.

items.title: Michael Penix: Three TDs in Week 7 win
items.text:
Penix completed 25 of 34 passes for 213 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions and added five carries for minus-1 yard in the Falcons' 29-20 win over the 49ers on Sunday. He also recovered a fumble.

items.title: George Kittle: Critical fumble in Week 7 loss
items.text:
Kittle brought in eight of 10 targets for 88 yards and lost a fumble in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.
